meta.title: ovyrn — a dashboard and monitoring panel for Telegram bots
meta.description: Manage your existing Telegram bots, track uptime, and store files right inside Telegram — no servers of your own required.
hero.title:
A dashboard for bots
that already work
hero.lead: Connect an existing Telegram bot, track its uptime and webhook, and store files directly in Telegram — no storage servers needed.
trust.text: Built in the open — progress and technical decisions in the blog
steps.title: Three steps to your first report
steps.sub: No new code in your bot — the panel works on top of what's already there.
steps.1.title: Paste the token
steps.1.text: The token from @BotFather — same as for any other integration. Keys are encrypted, only you have access.
steps.2.title: Choose a check interval
steps.2.text: From once every 10 minutes on the free plan to once every 30 seconds on Pro — you decide how fast you want to know about downtime.
steps.3.title: Get alerted
steps.3.text: Email or a Telegram message the moment your bot stops responding or the webhook returns an error.
features.title: Connect a bot in 10 minutes
features.sub: No trips to BotFather every time you need to tweak the name or the command menu.
features.1.title: Bot management
features.1.text: Name, description, photo, and command menu — right from the panel, with a live chat preview.
features.2.title: Monitoring 24/7
features.2.text: Uptime checks, response speed, and webhook diagnostics — you'll hear about downtime before your users do.
features.3.title: Storage in Telegram
features.3.text: Files fly into a service chat and stay stored on Telegram's side for free — generous limits with no servers of your own.
features.4.title: Notifications
features.4.text: An email or Telegram message the moment your bot stops responding.
features.5.title: Webhook diagnostics
features.5.text: See a stuck certificate or delivery errors from getWebhookInfo without manual requests.
features.6.title: Any bot
features.6.text: Doesn't matter what it's written in or who built it — a token from BotFather is all you need.
mockup.title: One glance and it all makes sense
mockup.sub: Your bots, their status and uptime — on a single screen, no switching between BotFather chats.
order_teaser.title: Don't have a bot yet? We'll build one for you
order_teaser.sub: From a simple info bot to complex logic with payments and integrations.
pricing_cta.title: Start for free, grow when you need to
pricing_cta.sub: Free — 1 bot forever. Paid plans scale with bot count and storage.
